projection_options.name: Compatibility Projection
projection_options.security: Positive allowlists at root and every nested object; remove gate_pipeline/developer_core/raw understanding/problem/unsupported sentences/source entirely, reconstruct reviewed safe scalars.
projection_options.compatibility: Preserves demonstrated answer/citation/evaluation/UI keys. Legacy nested contract checks and raw diagnostics impacted; full compatibility NOT_PROVEN.
projection_options.scope: Prefer app/api/routes.py private response projector and safe local error detail plus proposed direct tests; optional shared error handler requires separate path-limited approval.

recommended_option: C — explicit compatibility allowlist, no diagnostic endpoint

compatibility_assessment.ui_internal_fields: PROVEN generic raw JSON drawer sees entire state.lastResponse; no named gate_pipeline/developer_core application logic found in inspected UI
compatibility_assessment.evaluator: SOURCE_PROVEN uses response and evidence.chunk/document_id; keep these approved citation fields
compatibility_assessment.legacy_contract_script: SOURCE_PROVEN requires understanding.input/output; reduced nested projection breaks those checks pending owner migration decision
compatibility_assessment.diagnostic_script: SOURCE_PROVEN developer_core display if present; removing it removes diagnostic visibility
compatibility_assessment.versioning: Owner must decide/document breaking field removal and release notice. Same POST/input/answer semantics can remain, but response schema tightens. If versioning needed, version only reviewed safe schema; never retain insecure raw legacy output for compatibility. No new response version field or route implemented.

target_projection.internal_execution: Unchanged engines/shadow gate/memory/developer computations; project only at outbound boundary, never mutate gate_context. Server-side retention remains existing, no extra raw memory logging.
target_projection.evidence_policy: Owner must approve citation disclosure domain/scope; if not proven safe, omit that citation. Does not promote fixture/snapshot authority. Trust retains existing six-field assessment; evidence_count is assessment count, not automatically public citation count; owner review must document this difference without recomputing TrustEngine.
target_projection.types_and_absence: Allowlisted fields have reviewed types/bounds; missing optional scalars omitted or neutral under approved schema; no dict passthrough, arbitrary object serializer or stringify fallback. Unknown root/nested fields rejected from projection.
target_projection.error_projection: Reviewed generic local 500 detail; timeout503/504 public messages remain bounded. Framework validation/provider error path review mandatory; any shared change must be scoped to /v1/chat only.

security_risks.risk: Raw gate_context exposes internal reasoning/policy and newly added nested fields automatically.
security_risks.mitigation: Positive root/nested allowlist, no raw object serialization.

security_risks.risk: Removing only gate_pipeline leaves developer_core.orchestration.data mirrors and gates policy status.
security_risks.mitigation: Drop full developer_core at public boundary; scan/test duplicated paths.

security_risks.risk: Success-only projector leaves HTTP500 exception interpolation or framework error detail exposure.
security_risks.mitigation: Generic route error projection and authorized review of framework/shared provider validation response boundaries.

privacy_risks.risk: Previous turns and internal memory metadata are returned under gate_pipeline.memory and duplicate orchestration paths; caller session label not owner proof.
privacy_risks.mitigation: Exclude every memory/history path and avoid raw logs. Does not fix CC-05 owner binding/TTL/state separation.

privacy_risks.risk: Raw citations/source, understanding/problem dumps and unsupported sentences may carry unrelated/private input or document content.
privacy_risks.mitigation: Explicit nested scalar/citation allowlists with owner-approved disclosure, not automatic publication.

compatibility_risks.risk: UI raw drawer and standalone script contract/nested understanding fields change; unknown clients NOT_PROVEN.
compatibility_risks.mitigation: Preserve demonstrated safe keys, owner-approved schema/release migration and compatibility verification after authorized implementation.

architecture_risks.risk: Boundary-only projector can remain within route; no engine or configuration change needed.
architecture_risks.mitigation: Do not merge policy, redesign memory, add router/agent/diagnostic endpoint.

regression_risk: Branches, optional/null contexts and exception handling may produce differing shapes; designed branch/sentinel tests required after authorization; projection never changes grounding or trust computations.
rollback_risk: Previous source already has CC-01 exposure. Restoring it on a public production boundary reopens privacy risk; quarantine isolated candidate/hold release instead of silently restoring insecure public output.
diagnostic_boundary_requirements: Explicit server-side role/scope for diagnostics and session ownership
Minimal redacted diagnostic subset, not raw memory/reasoning dumps
Never caller-provided role/session label as authorization
No ordinary /v1/chat diagnostic passthrough, debug flag or legacy opt-in
Separate proposal/approval; no new endpoint/auth implementation in initial remediation
